title: Bell with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>

      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>

    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='40%'>

  <rect x='18' y='76' width='64' height='6' rx='3' fill='#E6A800'/>

  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3A2A00'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3A2A00'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='2' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='2' fill='#FFF8CC'/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FF8866' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FF8866' opacity='0.7'/>
